description: parity-cc-routing's log events (log-record.v1, parity-contracts 0.13.0), owned here since phase 8. Started from logging/examples/events.parity-cc-routing.v1.json. The common events (service.*, config.*, log.dropped, dependency.*) come from logging/events.common.v1.json. Call-scoped events carry the xsid (the interaction id) and tenant_id; scripts/ci.sh validates a scenario run's records with contract-check --catalogue.

agent.lend_refused.description: Campaign lending: an agent was not lent because it would leave an open queue uncovered (attrs.reason coverage).

agent.mode_changed.description: Campaign lending: the agent switched between inbound and campaign (attrs.reason: lent, returned, logged_out); also on agent.events as mode_changed.

agent.selected.description: RE chose an agent for a caller (the next step is offer.sent). decision: the candidates (READY agents that could take it, longest idle first) with their tier and idle time; on one offer in 100 at info (sampled), never otherwise.

agent.state_changed.description: An agent's routing state moved (from_state, to_state: logged_out, not_ready, ready, offered, reserved, on_call, wrap_up).

callback.dispatched.description: RE sent RunCallback: IE places the callback's call (its own xsid; parent_xsid is the call that asked for it).

callbacks.loaded.description: A tenant's open callbacks were loaded from Postgres (attrs.open).

campaign.reserved.description: Campaign lending (phase 8): the campaign's leader reserved a lent agent for this campaign call (ReserveAgent).

entry.dequeued.description: IE took the entry out of its queue without an agent (attrs.reason: abandoned, transferred, callback, voicemail, ended, ...); duration_ms is the time in the queue.

entry.enqueued.description: A caller joined a queue (or a direct or consult target): the entry RE made for IE's Enqueue. attrs: enqueue_seq, priority, the EnqueueReason, the position and VIP.

entry.overflowed.description: The entry reached its queue's max wait: the overflow action (attrs.action) goes to IE as Overflow.

forecast.fallback.description: Phases 5b+5c: the learned forecaster stopped driving a queue and the baseline stands (attrs.reason: no_model, stale, above_range, drift, ratio, width, realized_error, nan, negative, slow); logged on each entry into the fallback, not per evaluation.

forecast.model_demoted.description: Phases 5b+5c: the model in use was worse than the baseline over 24 h: a fine-tuned model is demoted (the tenant falls back to the base model), the base model is set aside for the tenant (the baseline then).

forecast.model_loaded.description: Phases 5b+5c: a forecaster model was loaded (version 0: the shared base model at startup; else a tenant's active model from routing_forecast_model).

forecast.model_promoted.description: Phases 5b+5c: a tenant's candidate beat the baseline and the model in use by >= 5 % WAPE over its shadow window and became active.

forecast.model_rejected.description: Phases 5b+5c: a tenant's candidate did not beat both after its shadow window (or saw too few calls) and was rejected.

forecast.source_changed.description: Phases 5b+5c: the forecast a queue's CTMC uses changed source (from_state/to_state: model or the baseline's ewma, ewma_profile, config_default), after the hysteresis.

inbox.refused.description: Requests refused UNAVAILABLE by the shards' inbox limits (attrs.count since the last record).

leader.elected.description: This replica won its bin's election (leader_epoch: the leader key's create revision).

leader.lost.description: Leadership lost: the process exits so it restarts as a standby.

leader.seen.description: The bin's leader key changed (attrs.leader: its gRPC address, or none).

model.refused.description: Phases 5b+5c: a forecaster model was refused before use (attrs.reason: missing, bad_metadata, bad_config, sha256, sha256_pin, config, archive, nonfinite, written_by): the base model at startup (exit 2) or a tenant's row (skipped, counted).

model.rolled_back.description: parity-cc-routing-trainer rollback: the active model retired and the previous version re-activated.

model.written.description: parity-cc-routing-trainer finetune: a candidate row was inserted for the tenant (version, sha256, the holdout WAPE against the baseline).

offer.accepted.description: The agent accepted: a reservation exists, Assigned goes to IE; duration_ms is the caller's time in the queue.

offer.expired.description: The offer timed out: the agent goes not ready (missed_offer); the caller keeps its place and is offered on.

offer.rejected.description: The agent rejected the offer, or went not ready or logged out while offered (attrs.answered false); the caller is offered on.

offer.revoked.description: RE withdrew the offer (the caller left, the agent's desktop detached): the agent is READY again, no penalty.

offer.sent.description: An offer went to the agent's gateway session (agents.v1 Offer). attrs: the offer id, its timeout and the tier.

owner.lost.description: The call's IE owner is gone (L18: no stream and no RPC, or nothing acknowledged): its entry and reservations are cleaned up.

owner.lost_calls.description: Calls cleaned up because their IE owner was gone (attrs.count since the last record; owner.lost has each call).

request.refused.description: An RPC was refused (error.code: the contract's code; op: the RPC); one record per (op, code) a second, the rest counted in repeat_count (CR-069).

reservation.expired.description: No outcome by the assignment's deadline + 2 s (L7): RE revoked it and the caller is back in its queue.

reservation.reported.description: IE reported how the assignment went (attrs.outcome: connected, agent_no_answer, caller_gone, ...); the first outcome wins.

startup.refused.description: The process refused to start (a flag, the state dir, a port, HA): error.message says why; it exits 1 or 2.

state.fenced.description: re.state's transactional producer is fenced and the topic read to the end (a takeover's first step).

state.flush_incomplete.description: The drain ended before everything was committed to re.state.

store.write_fenced.description: A callback write or load was fenced: a newer owner holds the tenant in Postgres.

stream.closed_slow.description: Watch streams closed for a slow consumer; they replay on reconnect (attrs.count since the last record).

sweep.matched.description: The 1 s safety sweep made offers dispatch had missed: a bug (attrs.count since the last record).

takeover.done.description: A new leader rebuilt every tenant from re.state and serves (attrs.takeover_ms, records, tenants).

tenant.arrived.description: A tenant arrived from another bin and was rebuilt from re.state (attrs.records, handover).

tenant.assignment_ignored.description: tp/tenants: a tenant's key was deleted or unreadable; the last assignment stands.

tenant.handover_missing.description: A tenant arrived without the leaving bin's handover (waited 5 s).

tenant.moved_away.description: A tenant moved to another bin: the handover is written (attrs.target_bin, tenant_epoch).

trainer.finished.description: parity-cc-routing-trainer: the base model was written (sha256, steps, validation loss, the holdout WAPE of H1 and H2 for the model and the baseline).

trainer.progress.description: parity-cc-routing-trainer: every 500 steps, the training loss (EMA) and the validation loss.

trainer.refused.description: parity-cc-routing-trainer: a run stopped (no database, the base model refused, the tenant's history unreadable, a model that can't be serialized).

trainer.started.description: parity-cc-routing-trainer (phases 5b+5c): a base or fine-tune run started (attrs.mode).

wrap_up.ended.description: The agent's wrap-up ended (attrs.ended_by: agent or limit); WrapUpEnded goes to IE, the disposition to agent.events.

wrap_up.started.description: IE's CallEnded: the agent's wrap-up started (attrs.ends_in_ms: the limit).
